summary_zh:
維克鎮對於觀光客的重要性，遠大過於雷克雅維克，維克鎮雖然小，但行經南部景點，他都是非常舉足輕重的重要性，加油、採買、住宿，這裡都非常的方便。

推薦一到 Vik 就到鎮上的 Krone 檸檬超市，這裡有「餐廳、超商、紀念品站、廁所」，你旅途需要的這裡全都有。
summary_en: Vik is far more important to tourists than Reykjavik; although the town is small, it plays a crucial role when traveling through the southern attractions, offering convenient fuel, shopping, and accommodation. The recommended stop is the Krone Lemon supermarket in town, which provides a restaurant, convenience store, souvenir shop, and restrooms—all the essentials you need for your journey. Parking and restroom facilities are free. A suggested stay time is about 90 minutes.
